out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the BOTTOM OF THE BACK DOOR.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. PIC HAS PLANS TO REPAIR BACK DOOR TO ENSURE IT IS FULLY SEALED TO THE FRAME WHEN IT IS SHUT. PLEASE ENSURE IT IS REPAIRED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: OBSERVED FOOD IN CONTAINERS STORED ON FLOOR IN WALK-IN FREEZER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PLEASE ENSURE ALL FOOD ITEMS ARE ELEVATED OFF THE FLOOR TO PREVENT CONTAMINATION AND ALLOW FOR EASY CLEANING.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED SOME SMALL HOLES IN THE BACK KITCHEN CEILING NEAR THE TWO-DOOR UPR COOLER/TWO-DOOR FREEZER.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. PLEASE ENSURE THESE SMALL HOLES ARE SEALED WITH FOAMING CAULK OR NEW CEILING TILES AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety foods are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours: OBSERVED COOKED CHICKPEAS IN TWO-DOOR UPR COOLER AT 107-119F MADE APPROXIMATELY 2-3 HOURS PRIOR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. PIC DISCARDED CHICKPEAS DURING INSPECTION. PROPER COOLING PARAMETERS WERE DISCUSSED WITH STAFF.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED MULTIPLE GALLONS OF MILK AT 49-50F, DICED TOMATOES AT 50F, HALF AND HALFS AT 51-52F, SMALL INDIVIDUAL PORTIONS OF CREAMERS AT 54F, AND SOUP BASE AT 52F IN WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC UNDERSTANDS COLD HOLDING FOODS MUST BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW. PIC DISCARDED OF FOODS DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS THE WALK-IN COOLER SHOULD NOT BE USED TO COLD HOLD TCS FOODS UNTIL IT HAS BEEN REPAIRED.

out_items.name: Compliance with variance, specialized process, HACCP

violations.title: HACCP Plan Required by Law
violations.observation: THE ESTABLISHMENT DOES NOT HAVE A VARIANCE/HACCP PLAN IN PLACE AND IS MAKING YOGURT FROM SCRATCH; THE PROCESS DOES NOT MEET COOLING PARAMETER REQUIREMENTS.
violations.corrective_action: PIC WILL DISCONTINUE SERVICE OF SCRATCH MADE YOGURT. PIC UNDERSTANDS A HACCP PLAN/VARIANCE IS REQUIRED IF THE RESTAURANT WANTS TO SERVE YOGURT MADE FROM SCRATCH AGAIN. PLEASE CONTACT THE EHS IF THE FACILITY WANTS TO CREATE A HACCP PLAN/SUBMIT A VARIANCE TO MAKE YOGURT AGAIN. DESI BREAKFAST CLUB (Inspection Date: 05/29/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED WALK-IN COOLER AT 54F AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC DISCARDED OF IMPROPERLY COLD HOLDING FOODS DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS THE WALK-IN COOLER SHOULD NOT BE USED TO HOLD TCS FOODS UNTIL IT HAS BEEN REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 34-38F. PIC CONTACTED A CONTRACTOR DURING THE INSPECTION TO REPAIR THE COOLER. PLEASE FOLLOW-UP WITH THE EHS WHEN THE COOLER HAS BEEN REPAIRED.
